theorem_statement: For every closed cycle in the fifteen-channel quotient, the product of native V4 edge voltages is invariant under independent changes of local chamber representative. Individual edge voltages are gauge-dependent, while cycle holonomy and every character evaluation of that holonomy are gauge-invariant.

interpretation.earned: The native cover retains a discrete memory of closed return. A loop may return to its starting quotient channel while returning with character 1, a, b, or ab.
interpretation.closure_language: Edge voltage records local presentation. Cycle holonomy records the residual character of return.
